title: EspressoLab real-shot capture record
description: One physically brewed espresso shot, recorded for validating the simulator against reality. Deliberately NOT the measured-shot document that `espressolab_cli calibrate` reads (assets/measured_shots/, engine/calibration/calibration_io.cpp): a capture record describes the shot and its provenance in full, including everything the machine did not measure. A capture is promoted to a measured shot only after the fields the solver needs are all present and non-null.
$comment: Kept synchronized with tests/schemas/real_shot_capture_check.py, which is the executable contract (stdlib-only, run in CI). Missing values are ALWAYS null, never a placeholder string and never an estimate. See docs/real-shot-validation.md.

status.description: `measured` = brewed and recorded under this repository's protocol. `external_public` = transcribed from a public third-party record; check `provenance.license` before redistributing. `pending_capture` = a slot reserved by the protocol with no shot brewed yet; every observable is null.

utc_timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC instant the shot started (pump-on), e.g. 2026-09-01T08:14:03Z. Null only while status is pending_capture.

protocol_version.description: Version of the capture protocol in docs/real-shot-validation.md that this shot followed.

source.description: Who produced the numbers, e.g. 'first-party capture' or 'visualizer.coffee'.

license.description: Verbatim license of the underlying data. Null means unknown, which forbids redistribution of the raw record.

data_quality_flags.description: Known defects, e.g. 'pressure sensor measures pump not puck', 'single TDS reading', 'grind setting is a dial number, no PSD'.

calibration_eligible.description: May this shot be used to FIT coefficients? Never true for external_public or pending_capture.

validation_eligible.description: May this shot be scored as a held-out validation case? Mutually exclusive with calibration_eligible for any one fit.

basket.description: Basket make, nominal dose and hole pattern, e.g. 'VST 18 g ridgeless'.

pressure_sensor_measures.description: Pump pressure is not puck pressure. Recording which one was logged is mandatory; `unknown` is an honest answer, a guess is not.

temperature_sensor_location.description: Physical location of the logged temperature probe, e.g. 'group head thermofilter, 2 mm above shower screen'. A boiler or PID setpoint is NOT a sensor location.

dial_setting.description: Recorded verbatim as text, e.g. '6.5 @ 1500 rpm'. A string on purpose: a dial number is not a length and must never be converted into microns.

measured.description: True only if a particle size distribution was physically measured for THIS grind setting.

method.description: e.g. 'laser diffraction, wet dispersion, Malvern Mastersizer 3000'. Required whenever measured is true.

distribution.description: Binned PSD in the same shape as a recipe's puck.grind, so a measured grind can be fed to the solver without reinterpretation. Empty when nothing was measured.

roast_date.description: ISO date. Never inferred from a bag photo or a purchase date.

storage.description: e.g. 'one-way valve bag, sealed, 21 C, opened 4 days before'.

filter_paper.description: Below-puck paper filter, or null if none used.

puck_depth_mm.description: Tamped bed depth. A solver input the machine never reports -- measure it (basket depth minus headspace) or leave it null.

recipe_name.description: e.g. 'Rao/Perger Ideal', 'third-wave water espresso profile', 'municipal, unfiltered'.

setpoint_c.description: What the machine was told to do. NOT an observation: never copy this into measured_c.

measured_c.description: Physically measured brew-water temperature. Non-null requires measurement_point and measurement_method.

profile_description.description: The commanded profile in words. The telemetry CSV carries what actually happened.

convention.description: What t=0 means, for both this record and the telemetry CSV. Comparing a pump-on shot time against a first-drip one is the single easiest way to invent a two-second error.

end_condition.description: e.g. 'stopped by scale at 36.0 g target', 'stopped by hand at 30 s'.

filtered.description: Whether the sample was syringe-filtered before reading. Unfiltered espresso reads high.

readings_percent.description: Every individual reading, not just the mean.

extraction_yield_source.description: `computed` = tds_percent * beverage_yield_g / dose_g, checked by the contract test. `measured` = the cup was dried and weighed.

csv.description: Path relative to this file. Null when no telemetry was logged.

columns.description: Must be exactly the target column set when csv is non-null.

taste.description: Recorded for the log only. Taste is never a calibration target (assets/measured_shots/README.md).

raw_shot_file.description: Untouched machine export (Decent .shot, Visualizer JSON, Gaggiuino CSV) kept verbatim beside the record.

telemetry_csv.description: Same path as telemetry.csv; repeated here so the attachment list is complete.

recipe.description: Path to the EspressoLab recipe that reproduces this shot's inputs. Null until every required model input is measured.

unavailable_model_inputs.description: Solver inputs this capture cannot supply. Non-empty means the shot is not simulable without inventing a number, so `recipe` stays null.

comparable_observables.description: Exactly what may be scored against a simulation. Curve entries are permitted only when the telemetry CSV shares timing.convention with the simulation.
